import bpy
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['reference_authoring']
exec("
import bmesh
# Correct the upward-facing deck and roof surfaces before applying modifiers.
for o in bpy.data.objects:
    if o.type=='MESH' and (o.name=='Boat_Deck' or o.name.startswith('Hut_ThatchedCourse')):
        bm=bmesh.new();bm.from_mesh(o.data);bmesh.ops.reverse_faces(bm,faces=list(bm.faces));bm.to_mesh(o.data);bm.free()
def export_collection(cname,filename):
    source=bpy.data.collections[cname]
    temp=collection('Export_'+cname)
    groups={}
    dg=bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    for o in list(source.objects):
        if o.type!='MESH':continue
        data=bpy.data.meshes.new_from_object(o.evaluated_get(dg),preserve_all_data_layers=True,depsgraph=dg)
        ob=bpy.data.objects.new(o.name+'_export',data);temp.objects.link(ob);ob.matrix_world=o.matrix_world.copy()
        key=o.data.materials[0].name if o.data.materials else 'None'
        # Keep floor and foliage component classes legible to runtime collision policy.
        prefix='Leaf' if any(w in o.name for w in ['Crown','Frond','Tuft','Coconut']) else 'Solid'
        groups.setdefault((prefix,key),[]).append(ob)
    final=[]
    for (prefix,key),objects in groups.items():
        bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
        for ob in objects:ob.select_set(True)
        bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=objects[0]
        if len(objects)>1:bpy.ops.object.join()
        ob=objects[0];ob.name=prefix+'_'+key
        final.append(ob)
    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
    for o in final:o.select_set(True)
    bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=final[0]
    bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=str(OUT/filename),export_format='GLB',use_selection=True,export_apply=True,export_yup=True,export_texcoords=True,export_normals=True,export_materials='EXPORT',export_extras=True)
    triangles=sum(sum(len(p.vertices)-2 for p in o.data.polygons) for o in final)
    print(filename,len(final),'meshes',triangles,'triangles')
    for o in list(temp.objects):bpy.data.objects.remove(o,do_unlink=True)
    bpy.data.collections.remove(temp)
for c,f in [('Reference_Terrain','terrain.glb'),('Reference_Ocean','ocean.glb'),('Reference_Coast','coast.glb'),('Reference_Foliage','foliage.glb'),('Reference_Rocks','rocks.glb'),('Reference_Boat','boat.glb')]+[('Reference_Cargo_'+c,'cargo_'+c+'.glb') for c in ['jade','silk','ginseng','nutmeg']]:
    export_collection(c,f)
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(ROOT/'source/reference_harbor_mcp.blend'))
print('REFERENCE_EXPORT_COMPLETE')
",ns)
